# Recreation Prompt

Recreate Cozy Crown Borough as a portrait-first browser-native city-builder tycoon. Preserve the mechanic truth of the source: start with $600, a 10x10 grid, shop categories, queued building placement on empty parcels, passive income every roughly two seconds, tap-to-collect ready money, population-based level increases using floor(population / 10) + 1, utility resource blocking, drag panning, long-press info, and 5x5 expansion. Transform the public-facing identity into a satirical fairycore/cottagecore city builder where a crown-kitty planner helps the player place ribbon roads, mushroom homes, decora shops, fairy glowmills, and tea cisterns in a moonlit pastel borough. Use mobile-readable HUD copy: Sparkles, residents, Glow, Tea, Crown Rank, Build Atelier, and Queued Permit. Use procedural Canvas/CSS art rather than stock backgrounds: bow clouds, fairy lights, rounded parcel board, pastel silhouettes, sparkle feedback, and large one-thumb controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first canvas city builder / idle tycoon sandbox.
- objective: place buildings on a square grid, collect generated money, grow population, unlock higher-rank build options, and expand the map.
- input model: tap start; tap shop and category buttons; tap a buy/queue button; tap an empty parcel to place; tap ready money bubbles to collect; drag the canvas to pan; long press a built tile for details.
- core loop: start with $600 and a 10x10 grid, select affordable structures, place them on empty tiles, wait for income to accrue every about two seconds, collect income, use population to raise level, unlock stronger structures and expansion.
- fail/friction state: no hard loss; placement can be blocked by insufficient money, glow/power, or tea/water and provides feedback while preserving the session.

## Protected mechanics
- Starting money, 10x10 initial grid, 5x5 expansion, cost/income/population/resource values, unlock levels, and population-to-level formula are preserved.
- One-thumb controls are preserved: shop/select/place/collect, drag pan, long press info, and cancel queued tool.
- Passive income cadence and ready-money collection semantics are preserved.
- Placement remains tile-based, in-bounds, and only on empty parcels.
- Resource capacity/consumption blocking remains deterministic and non-terminal.

## Remixed target
Cozy Crown Borough reframes the source loop as a satirical fairycore/cottagecore mobile city-builder tycoon. The player is a slay-queen kitty planner placing ribbon roads, mushroom housing, decora shops, and glow/tea utilities in a moonlit before-bed borough. The mechanic truth remains city-building and population growth; the public presentation, HUD language, focal mascot, procedural background, building silhouettes, and feedback have been regenerated into an authored pastel world.
